sections.title: A managed search—not a promise of employment.
paragraphs: In reverse recruiting, the professional engages support to organize parts of their job search. KOV's work can include research, positioning, opportunity review, applications, recruiter and hiring-manager outreach, follow-up, interview preparation and offer support.
The exact activities and approvals are defined in the engagement. Employers retain control of interviews, selection and offers; KOV does not guarantee interviews, placement or timing.

sections.title: Set a target that respects your constraints.
paragraphs: Before execution, KOV and the professional discuss seniority, function, industry, geography, timing and practical requirements. Search boundaries can include current-employer exclusions, location constraints and communication preferences.
This makes it possible to focus on roles that fit your priorities rather than measuring progress by application volume alone.

sections.title: Keep the process visible and the decisions yours.
paragraphs: KOV coordinates agreed search activity and communicates progress using the process established for the engagement. You remain involved in decisions about target fit, applications, external messages and opportunities.
Fees, deliverables and expectations are discussed directly by message and agreed in writing before work begins. Client information is shared only according to the agreed communication process.

faqs.question: Is reverse recruiting the same as an employer hiring a recruiter?
faqs.answer: No. In KOV's candidate practice, the professional engages KOV for agreed job-search support. Employers make their own hiring decisions and are not represented by this candidate-side service.

faqs.question: Does reverse recruiting guarantee a job?
faqs.answer: No. KOV can manage agreed search activities, but cannot control employer decisions, market conditions or hiring timelines.

That narrative can guide your resume, LinkedIn profile, networking conversations and recruiter outreach. Any claims used in your materials should be accurate and supportable.
